title: Apache RR 310 BTO Carbon (Pro Spec)
description: Representing TVS Motor Company's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the TVS Motor Company Apache RR 310 BTO Carbon (Pro Spec) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
